title: AgentConfig
description:
Agent configuration. Source of truth for `docs/src/generated/agent-config.md`.

Required to find the server: `ingest_url`, `ingest_token`, `node_id`, `buffer_dir`, and optional `docker.host`. Poll interval, Docker enable/manage/exec, labels, and compose paths are node Settings once connected; TOML is the fallback until then.

buffer_dir.description: Directory for on-disk push buffer when the server is unreachable.

ingest_token.description: Shared ingest token. This cannot call Docker manage APIs.

interval_secs.description: Push interval in seconds. Default 1. Fallback until the node's Settings poll interval is applied at runtime.

labels.description: Extra labels attached to every heartbeat. Fallback until the node's Settings labels are applied at runtime.

node_id.description: Stable node id. Defaults to hostname when empty.

DockerConfig.description:
Docker Engine access on this node.

Socket access is root-equivalent. `manage` is opt-in. `allow_exec` is a further gate because exec is a root shell on the host namespaces.

allow_exec.description: Allow `docker exec`. Default false. Fallback until Settings.

compose_paths.description: Extra Compose file paths. Fallback until node Settings apply.

enabled.description: Observe Docker (list/inspect/stats/logs) via the engine socket. Fallback until node Settings `docker_enabled` is applied.

host.description: Engine socket or TCP URL. Empty uses `/var/run/docker.sock`. Stays in this file (not a UI setting).

manage.description: Allow mutating Docker operations. Opt-in. Fallback until Settings.
